programme.sub-title: My Dad Was The Breast Pump Bandit (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Wake-Up Call for the Nation Pt 1
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. Rheta says it's time for Mark to cut the cord with the woman she calls deceitful, backstabbing, sneaky and controlling -- or else! Meanwhile, Deb says she hates Rheta, claiming she's violent, trashy and undeserving of her son. The tension between the women has escalated to blows on more than one occasion, leaving Mark literally in the middle. Where do his loyalties lie? Hear the drastic measures Deb has taken to get Rheta out of their lives. And, did Rheta reveal a secret in the hopes of ruining Deb's 31-year marriage? Is this a case of an overprotective mom overstepping her boundaries, or a wife's resentment getting the best of her? Dr. Phil mediates this war of words and helps to draw some lines in the sand. Whose side will Mark be on? Can this marriage and family be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Did Walt Kill His Ex? The Polygraph (Pt 2)
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Rachel, who accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The drama continues as Dr. Phil goes on the hunt for con artists who cheat viewers out of thousands of dollars by posing as him and Robin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Driven To Try And Kill Her Child? (Pt. 2)
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his exclusive jailhouse interview with Kelli Stapleton, a mother accused of trying to kill herself and her severely autistic 14-year-old daughter, Issy. Were there any warning signs that she was reaching her breaking point? And, find out how you can help Issy secure a healthy and productive future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Mom Tried To Kill Autistic Child (Pt. 1)
programme.desc: In September 2013, Kelli Stapleton and her 14-year-old daughter, Issy -- who suffers from severe autism -- were found in the family van, suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning. Could Kelli have done the unthinkable? In a Dr. Phil exclusive, the jailed Michigan mom opens up about what happened.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Doug and Debbie's once-perfect family has been shattered by the frightening reality that they could lose their 21-year-old son, Brandon, to drugs. Dr. Phil lays the groundwork for a successful intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Football Star Accused: Did He Do It?
programme.desc: In a Dr. Phil exclusive, a 17-year-old football star accused of rape -- and the alleged victim -- speak out about how one alcohol-fueled night changed their lives in an instant. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. In Part 2 of his exclusive interview, the 16-year-old girl who claims high school football star Matt and three other classmates raped her at a party opens up about what she says happened that night. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, Gabby Petito’s parents speak out all together for the first time since the 22-year-old “Van Life” vlogger's body was discovered in Grand Teton National Park in Wyoming. As the manhunt for her fiancé, Brian Laundrie, continues, they share their knowledge about his survival skills, and talk about the heartbreaking moment her stepfather had to identify Gabby. They also honor her life and memory, and discuss what they hope will be her legacy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Shotlanta
programme.desc: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Single Black Female
programme.desc: Rose is a young college freshman who meets her roommate Max for the first time. The two develop an intense bond, and Max is willing to prove her loyalty to Rose, even if it means someone will have to die if they get in the way.

programme.title: Aliens in the Hood
programme.desc: The hood politics of the neighborhood become even more complicated after the arrival of aliens! When one man in the neighborhood is blessed with superpowers, he and the other warring factions are headed to war over control of the current drug trade.

programme.title: Toxic King
programme.desc: Keeng is searching for love in all the wrong places. After years of trouble relationships, he decides to just be a playboy and become a “serial love hopper” that is until he reunites with Zuri, a college friend who he has always had a crush on. Will he fight for true love? Or resign to being a Toxic King?

programme.title: Love and Deceit 2
programme.desc: Carolyn, a successful businesswoman moves to a new town in hopes of laying down some roots after her divorce. She joins a local women’s group ran by Beverly Jordan a respected therapist to help process her emotions. When in reality, she’s there to rekindle an old flame with a former lover, who happens to be Beverly’s husband.

programme.title: Art of Murder
programme.desc: Detectives Trent Rollins and Latoya Cooper investigate a series of murders in which the victims all bear a mysterious symbol that’s connected to a previous murder of a known artist, Preston Sacher. As they close in, Rollins finds himself stuck between protecting his family, and doing what’s right.

programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
programme.desc: When rival gangster Derrick Smith is released from prison, the beef with Armand Rossi explodes into an all-out war in Fountain City, MO. After a hit on his family , Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge , but Rossi and his partner Qua stay ahead. When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programme.title: Commandments of a Female Hustler
programme.desc: Three childhood friends, Lala, Binky, and Jay grew up together on the streets of East Baltimore. Wanting a better life for themselves, they learn the ways of hustling. When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

programme.title: Camera Girl
programme.desc: After witnessing Atlanta’s underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: The Offer
programme.desc: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision. As tensions rise, secrets unravel, and old wounds reopen, the couple begins to fracture under the moral and emotional weight of the offer.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Prize In Each And Every Package
programme.desc: All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Day In The Life Of Oliver Wendell Holmes
programme.desc: After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Lisa's Mudder Comes For A Visit
programme.desc: Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You And Your Big Shrunken Head
programme.desc: When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: The Case Of The Hooterville Refund Fraud
programme.desc: After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Eb places an ad in a magazine claiming to be a wealthy landowner, it catches the eye of a young socialite. When the young woman makes an unexpected visit to Hooterville, Eb is forced to keep up his ruse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is upset when he finds out Arnold the pig and he share the same birthday. Jealous that Arnold is getting more attention than he is, Oliver becomes convinced that Lisa is throwing him a surprise party and drives all over town in search for it.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa play host to four children from the city, who find themselves in Hooterville as part of a rural exposure program. The kids learn how to milk the cow, pick vegetables, plant seeds, and share sleeping quarters with four-legged friends.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Shane LeHew
programme.desc: Shane LeHew relies on a jerkbait from late fall through the spawn whether using electronics or not. He keeps two color options: translucent for sunny or clear water and solid for cloudy or stained conditions.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Bryan Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt highlights how different SPRO Aruku Shad versions and hook sizes enhance performance based on season cover and action. He adjusts for fall rates with yo-yo or straight retrieves and downsizes when the bite is tough.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Stetson Blaylock
programme.desc: Stetson Blaylock relies on burning a crankbait over grass rock and stumps during late winter and pre-spawn. He ups his line size to keep the bait higher and uses a 7'4" rod for longer casts and ripping it free from grass.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Robert Gee
programme.desc: Robert Gee reflects on his 2024 success with largemouth smallmouth and spotted bass noting that spots and smallmouth chase differently than largemouth requiring presentation adjustments. He shares his preferred head sizes go-to knot and a simple rod and reel setup most anglers can use.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Emil Wagner
programme.desc: Emil Wagner sheds light on his favorite bait for winter fishing especially on spotted bass lakes like Lanier. With jig head minnows neko rigs and dropshots becoming popular everyone forgot about the shaky head.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Scott Martin
programme.desc: Scott Martin sets up the calendar for Florida's Spawn Cycle. Depending on weather spawn can start in south Florida as early as Thanksgiving week and extend through May of the next year. Martin gives his take on the difference of a lake like Okeechobee and the St. Johns River farther north.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Bill Lowen
programme.desc: Bill Lowen explains his two-pronged approach at the St. Johns River sticking to one area for four days using a black and blue swim jig and a flipping jig. He highlights his swim jig cadence and the importance of his flipping jig falling into hard cover

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Brandon Palaniuk
programme.desc: Brandon Palaniuk shares the three baits he used to win the Bassmaster Elite Series at Lake Okeechobee: a Megabass Kanata jerkbait and two Megabass crankbaits (Big M and a prototype). Fishing one spot aggressively led to some of the biggest strikes seen on Bassmaster LIVE.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Hunter Shryock
programme.desc: Hunter Shryock discusses the rising trend of using a swimbait in the prespawn as a substitute for commonly thrown baits with similar profiles. Fished around the same shallow cover it can trigger the big kicker bite tournament anglers seek.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Jason Williamson
programme.desc: Jason Williamson provides a solution to those tricky bass that are days from spawning and sit high in the water column. Not only does a jig provide great opportunities for good catches but a swimbait also entices those big females to commit.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Easton Fathergill
programme.desc: Easton Fothergill gives his daily adjustment to how fish were positioned each day of the Classic. From windy days to calm moments Fothergill kept adjusting his tackle to maximize efficiency.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Bob Downey
programme.desc: Bob Downey goes through what he would consider his spring selection for largemouth fishing. Spring means March and April in the south but can mean April May and June up north. Downey opts for a crankbait swim jig and two types of soft plastics when making the spring transition.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Bill Lowen
programme.desc: Bill Lowen goes through two baits he always has rigged up this time of year. A tube and a jig are staples in Lowen's boat and he explains how both get fished in conjunction with one another. There are a few variables like pegging his weight or letting it free flow and also line size in these situations.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Kyle Welcher
programme.desc: Kyle Welcher breaks down his single bait that produced a record winning margin and over 118 pounds of bass at the Pasquotank River. Flipping a Rapala CrushCity Bronco Bug to shallow roamers and spawning bass was his strategy. He utilized his forward facing sonar to pick out fish among the cover littered on the bottom.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Greg Hackney
programme.desc: The Shad Spawn is a unique stage of the fishing season that bridges the gap from the bass spawn into the post spawn. Shad spawning around hard shallow cover gives bass a great opportunity to feed heavily in a short window of time. Not all places in the country feature a shad spawn but if threadfin are present in your lake a shad spawn is likely to happen. Low-light conditions early in the morning are helpful and baits like a spinnerbait imitate small shad perfectly to load the boat for Greg Hackney in a hurry.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Paul Marks
programme.desc: Paul Marks shows off his single bait that produced in two different situations depending on how he rigged it. The Zoom Fluke Stick in Natural Shad contributed almost all of his weight in his Elite victory at Lake Hartwell. His first approach was rigging it weightless to throw on shallow points where bass pushed blueback herring to feed in the morning then he switch to a shakey head in the afternoons.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie discusses the tricky period immediately after bass leave the bed and are either guarding fry or recovering from the spawn. Here is how Christie opts to catch them.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Tucker Smith
programme.desc: Tucker Smith talks about finding hard spots on Lake Fork with his side imaging throughout practice and then using his forward facing sonar to execute and catch fish throughout the tournament. He utilized a 7-inch minnow on spinning tackle with varying head sizes as well as a 3/4-ounce football jig on the final day.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Pat Schlapper
programme.desc: Pat Schlapper recounts his finest tournament week to date where to took the title at the Sabine River. Schlapper relied on a few areas of the Sabine along with a few lures including a Do-It Molds compact jig he pours himself altering it with a smaller stouter hook. He also utilized a Brazalo Custom Lures Bushwhacker Buzz Bait in the morning on the final day when it put multiple quality fish in the boat.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Joey Cifuentes III
programme.desc: Joey Cifuentes tackles where the fish go when they finish spawning but the water temperatures aren't at their hottest yet like they will be later in the summer. Cifuentes dives into three different baits that are useful around lakes with standing timber for the last week of May as we head into June.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Bernie Schultz
programme.desc: Florida pro Bernie Schultz talks buzzbaits specifically two kinds. He keeps a squeaking buzzbait and clacking buzzbait ready to go at all times especially in the post-spawn. Although it's an excellent technique in the post-spawn Schultz acknowledges its use early in the year in places like Florida Texas and other southern states. Buzz it slow or fast make it clack or squeak add a toad or a trailer hook whatever you'd like with a buzzbait.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Stetson Blaylock
programme.desc: Stetson Blaylock explains a new bait he was introduced to that helps him catch not only deep northern smallmouth but also southern largemouth in the winter months. He also discusses the value in 2D sonar with this technique around structure in the south.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Matt Roberston
programme.desc: Matt Robertson talks about upsizing his spinnerbait and adjusting his blade sizes when throwing this lure in water temperatures varying from the 40's to 50's.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix gives his thoughts on when he picks up a Dropshot versus a Ned Rig and a Neko Rig. Speed is often the determining factor for each presentation and he tends to reserve the Neko for largemouth situations.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Shane LeHew
programme.desc: Shane LeHew talks about one of his favorite fun-fishing lures which is the Umbrella Rig aka Alabama Rig. LeHew utilizes this in multiple ways as he can cover water around shallow cover like he would with a spinnerbait but also with his electronics around deeper offshore structure.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Bryan New
programme.desc: Bryan New goes through some of the keys he likes in his jig when targeting bass in the prespawn. New breaks down his jig trailer and why it's efficient and also explains an adjustment to his jig size that he used to never use.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Kyle Welcher
programme.desc: Kyle Welcher gives his take on a few productive lures in the prespawn and how he balances their uses to be most effective while on the water. Should you use a Chatterbait where a jig could also work or vice versa he attacks this and more in this scenario.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Brandon Card
programme.desc: Brandon Card gives his thoughts on early season jerkbait fishing. Card gives scenarios when he will opt for a different cadence for his jerkbait rod length and line size.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Todd Auten
programme.desc: Todd Auten goes over three Chatterbait variations that have made the South Carolina pro successful with this technique. Whether it's color selection trailer options or getting the bait to ride high in the water column or fall fast Auten has his process. 1. White/CChartuese w/Zoom Shimmer Shad 2. Black/Blue w/Zoom ZCraw or Green Pumpkin Fluke 3. Firecraw w/Speed Craw

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Kyoya Fujita
programme.desc: Kyoya Fujita gives the specifics of his lures that helped him win at Toledo Bend. Fujita was using a technique called "mid-strolling" to get his Jackall Drift Fry and his Deps Sakamata Shad to the correct depth to target suspended bass.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Trey McKinney
programme.desc: Lake Fork Champion Trey McKinney gives his lure arsenal as he adjusted daily to the changing fish for the second stop of the Elite Series season. Early in the event he used a jerkbait and jig head minnow combo but as the weather warm and conditions changed his baits adapted. Culminating on the final day were multiple baits contributed to his 130-15 tournament weight.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Brad Whatley
programme.desc: Brad Whatley gives his strategy of covering water around the spawn when there is thicker cover present. Whatley winds his weighted swimbait around spawning areas and will trigger strikes or boils revealing where bass are positioned to catch on another tactic if necessary.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Kenta Kimura
programme.desc: Kenta Kimura gives some suggestions to be better with the Megabass Magdraft swimbait. He changes the treble to his signature Ryugi quad-hook design for better hookups and he also adds a split ring to the line tie for increased head action and roll. Those two things are essential for Kimura along with finding the right speed on retrieve.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Justin Hamner
programme.desc: Justin Hamner gives his strategy to catch key bass each day of competition and how he utilized multiple kinds of jerkbaits and mixed in a jig to catch the majority of his weight on Grand Lake in the 2024 Bassmaster Classic.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Bernie Schultz
programme.desc: Bernie Schultz gives his three trusted lures when he is covering water to develop a pattern in the spring. He balances a spinnerbait swim jig and chatterbait when he approaches different types of cover.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Kyle Patrick
programme.desc: Kyle Patrick gives his approach for fishing for less pressured fish during the spawning months of the year. The fishing myth around the spawn is that bass have to go to the bank to do their yearly spawn when in reality fish can spawn much deeper and will take longer to do so.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - John Garrett
programme.desc: John Garrett runs down the three baits that were key for his win on the Harris Chain of Lakes. Garrett rotated between these techniques depending on how the fish were positioned and their aggressiveness on the shell bar.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Cory Johnston
programme.desc: Cory Johnston goes over his two main lures for bed fishing at the St. Johns River en route to his first Elite Series victory. Johnston also explains his use of Perspective Mode when seeing bed fish in low visibility times.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Caleb Sumrall
programme.desc: Caleb Sumrall talks about one of the best ways to catch big bass. Sumrall strongly believes in a frog but when bass start shying away or missing it he downsizes instead of changing baits completely. When conditions change bass moods can vary and with that topwater becomes a high risk high reward situation and Sumrall will downsize to the keep the odds in his favor.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Seth Feider
programme.desc: Seth Feider goes through his wood jig and grass jig setup. He explains the differences in line tie and weed guard why he likes a short hook and his colors for flipping. Whether it's docks laydowns shoreline grass or submerged vegetation; Feider will often rely on a jig to get it done. His favorite size is a 5/8 ounce.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Elite Series Champion Patrick Walters gives the details of his approach at Lake Murray. Walters relied on a few baits throughout the week to win the event wire to wire. When fish were active and schooling Walters utilized a Zoom Super Fluke and a Rapala Jowler.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Timothy Dube
programme.desc: Tim Dube walks us through one of his favorite techniques in tournaments and fun fishing. Dube gives his take on practicing with a Glide Bait and his strategy to convert followers into fish that will commit to biting.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Bryan New
programme.desc: Bryan New lays out one of his favorite topwater presentations the Buzz Toad. Pioneered by his good friend and fellow Elite Todd Auten New likes to use this bait to imitate multiple types of forage bass will eat in the post-spawn.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - John Crews
programme.desc: John Crews offers a different option for enticing schooling fish to bite when it gets tough and pressured in the summer. Using a Spy Bait can offer up another look that is great for casting and mimicking baitfish.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Brock Mosley
programme.desc: Brock Mosley praises the most versatile lure in bass fishing the Yamamoto Senko. He shows how you can quickly switch from fishing the Senko weightless wacky rigged to adding a weight and changing the hook positioning for a Neko Rig. This lure will get fish to bite every day of the year depending on how you rig it.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Cliff Prince
programme.desc: Cliff Prince dials us in on his 1/2 ounce Chatterbait setup that helped him win the Bassmaster Elite at Wheeler Lake. He also dishes the details on his magic spot and why he thinks the morning was incredible every day for him.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Brandon Cobb
programme.desc: Brandon Cobb gives his top picks for effective baits on lakes with blueback herring. Spotted bass and largemouth will get hyper focused on blueback herring when they exist on a body of water and Cobb knows these baits will work throughout the year and not a certain specific season.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Taku Ito
programme.desc: Taku Ito goes through two key baits to his Bassmaster Elite Series victory at Smith Lake. From Neko Rigging a bluegill imitating bait to dropshotting a Magnum Fuzzy Dice he managed the biggest bass and bag to win.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Logan Parks
programme.desc: Logan Parks discusses a strategy he employed at Wheeler during his first Top 10. Varying line size can help crankbaits run different depth and retrieved faster or slower. It's something he recommends during the summer months when schools are forming offshore or have been fished for frequently.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 7th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, Joey Cifuentes takes the title at Lake St. Clair by going against the grain. Cowboy Cifuentes is a Rookie on the Elite Series but with two wins in 2023, he has wowed the fishing world.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie led three days of the Elite Series event at the Sabine River and rode a great two days of fishing to the winners circle in his return year to the Bassmaster Elites. He is the Marathon Peak Performance at the Sabine.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Through just 5 years on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Patrick Walters has an incredible resume. He added another accolade with a win at Lake Murray, doing so in impressive fashion. Congratulations to ‪@patrickwaltersfishing5121‬, he is the Marathon Peak Performance at the 5th stop of the 2024 season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - LukePalmer
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Luke Palmer has been dubbed as one of the most consistent pros early in his career. His first four years all found him in the 20’s for Angler of the Year and while he’s shown signs of his ability, wins have eluded him. Long before his emergence as a headliner, he�d written hits for White and Chaka Khan, while crafting a Grammy winning single for Leo Sayer - �You Make Me Feel Like Dancing� � for which he never received credit, a hard lesson in business that drove him to contemplate suicide. But Ray Parker proved unsinkable, and along with testimony from his extended musical family � including Cheryl Lynn, Chaka Khan and Clive Davis - he tells �Unsung� the tale of his still-unfolding journey.

programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.sub-title: FishON | Spring Thaw on Frederick House Lake
programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.title: FishON! | Weathering the Storm: Walleye on Porcupine Lake
programme.desc: In this exciting episode, we venture out onto Porcupine Lake for some beautiful walleye action with Craig Salmonson from Timmins Angling Adventures. Patience was key as we waited for a break in challenging weather conditions—but it all paid off with an unforgettable day on the water. Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga Tatsumi is a crazy-strong, ruthless high school delinquent who's nicknamed the "Rampaging Ogre". One day, while dunking some punk, he rescues a big guy who comes ~floating~ down the river. When he does, the big guy splits in half and out pops a bouncing baby boy! But this baby is actually Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV (Baby Beel), the son of the Great Demon Lord, and he came from the Demon World in order to destroy humanity!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga has been chosen to be the parent of Beelzebub, the son of the Great Demon Lord. However Oga's suffering since every time Baby Beel cries he lets out a severe electric shock. Plus, according to Baby Beel's demon maidservant Hildegarde (Hilda), if Baby Beel moves farther than 15 meters away from his human parent Oga, the electric shock will reach lethal levels. Oga shuffles to school with Baby Beel clinging to his back, having no other choice, and begins to search for someone even stronger than him that Baby Beel will take a liking to, in order to get this monkey off his back, literally!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga loses the powdered milk that Hilda prepared for him, and instead buys a bunch of "Yogurty" from a vending machine for Beel. But it turns out that's the favorite drink of one of Ishiyama's Big Four, the "Ishiyama Tohoshinki"; the third year Kanzaki Hajime. Oga hears about how horrible and ruthless a guy Kanzaki is, and runs into the third year classroom to try and dump Baby Beel off on him. When he sees Kanzaki's evil looking face, Oga thinks that this just might be his chance!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP41 Heroes and Vixens [English Dub]

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]

programme.title: Boys Over Flowers

programme.title: Boys Over Flowers
programme.desc: Yi-jung gets a frantic call from his mother threatening to commit suicide because of his father.

programme.title: Boys Over Flowers

programme.title: Boys Over Flowers

programme.title: Boys Over Flowers
